title: OpenAPI Import
description: Contracts for turning an OpenAPI 3 / Swagger 2 document into runnable apiCall flows. Parsing is deterministic (no LLM): each spec operation becomes one apiCall action whose config is an ApiCallConfig from action-configs.json, with assertions derived from the operation's declared responses.

OpenApiAuthKind.description: How generated requests authenticate, derived from the spec's security schemes

OpenApiImportRequest.description: POST /openapi/import request. Supply the document inline via `spec`; the server does not fetch remote URLs on the caller's behalf.

spec.description: The OpenAPI/Swagger document as JSON or YAML text

baseUrl.description: Overrides the server URL taken from the spec. Useful when the spec points at production and the tests should hit staging.

includeTags.description: When non-empty, only operations carrying one of these tags are imported

includeMethods.description: When non-empty, only these HTTP methods are imported (case-insensitive)

groupBy.description: 'tag' produces one flow per spec tag containing its operations; 'operation' produces one flow per operation.

generateAssertions.description: Derive response assertions from each operation's declared success response

folderId.description: Folder the generated tests are created in

persist.description: When true the generated flows are saved as tests; when false they are returned for preview only

OpenApiSkippedOperation.description: An operation the importer chose not to generate, and why. Surfaced so a short import is explainable rather than looking like operations silently vanished.

OpenApiGeneratedFlow.description: One generated flow. `flow` is a Flow graph whose nodes are apiCall actions; `testId` is set only when the import persisted it.

flow.description: Flow graph: { nodes, edges, variables, parameters }

title.description: Spec title, used to name the generated group

specVersion.description: Spec version string as declared by the document

baseUrl.description: Resolved base URL the generated requests target

variables.description: Typed placeholders the generated steps reference (auth token, path parameters)
